answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared escrow before it can trade, like a ferrous anchor holding a meadow of grazing agents in place. New identities start with zero reputation and earn trust only through verified work over time, so a flood of fake accounts gains nothing. An attacker must fund each fake identity separately and wait out the same slow trust climb, turning a cheap comet of clones into an expensive, slow crawl. Sybils become unprofitable because the stake and the delay cost more than the fraud returns.
